scientific_target: Count of optically active independent single-photon emitters; not total molecular stoichiometry or localization truth.

claims.statement: Physical first-arrival survival curves at transmissions 0,r,s,1 identify a finite positive brightness multiset up to scale and hence count, under a common unknown conditional arrival CDF and independent arbitrary Poisson optical/dark backgrounds.
claims.mechanism: J_a=log S_a-a log S_1-(1-a)log S_0 cancels both backgrounds. A nonlinear lifetime reparametrization cannot preserve J_r and J_s because c_k(a)/c_2(a) is strictly increasing for k>=3.
limits: Common emitter time profile is a physical premise, not learned validation.
Exact continuous-law identifiability only; finite precision and sample stability unproved.
No corresponding physical controls were acquired.
Variable attenuation itself is known detector-decoy prior art.
Localization and target-versus-contaminant identity not solved.

claims.statement: Two emitters with p=.06 and exponential lifetime tau have the same entire first-arrival/no-click law as one p=.1164 emitter with conditional lifetime survival (94 exp(-t/tau)+3 exp(-2t/tau))/97.
claims.limits: Does not equate their full multichannel coincidence records.

claims.statement: For the explicit eta=.12 one-versus-two hypotheses, every fixed-budget adaptive attenuation plus earliest-photon-time policy with both errors<=.05 requires at least71403 pulses; ideal balanced two-detector coincidence succeeds in1663.
claims.limits: Ideal isolated pulses, known common arrival CDF, no background or detector artifacts. Shot budget only, not complete hardware/economic cost.

claims.statement: A finite calibrated menu of saturated threshold click laws can be shared by different positive independent-emitter counts, using polynomial interpolation perturbations.
claims.limits: Not a countermodel to all archived SPC timestamps; raw records contain same-channel repeated detections. General finite-click tomography obstruction is known prior art.

claims.statement: Ideal complete PNR law identifies unequal positive Bernoulli-emitter probabilities and independent Poisson background by exponential-times-polynomial uniqueness.
claims.limits: Does not grant full PNR access to the actual SPAD archive or uniform finite-sample guarantees.

claims.statement: Every proposed digital contrast or first-arrival selection can be computed by an incumbent with the complete raw record; it cannot add statistical information. A computation or hardware saving would require a separate demonstrated cost comparison.

acquired_evidence_boundary.a09_actions: Read source and team replay artifacts, independently rehashed raw archive, derived proofs, executed exact arithmetic verifier.

decision.STOP: New information or capability claims from digital thinning, timing collapse, or this contrast over the same complete multichannel records.
decision.HOLD: Physical four-setting operation until actual joint settings, premise controls, independent count truth, finite stability and matched cost comparison exist.
decision.GO: Preserve conditional mathematical result and explicit countermodels as scoped research capital.
